note: Source of truth for the plan. Agents: read AGENTS.md, and change status only through scripts/plan.mjs. size: 1 = up to a week, 2 = one to two weeks, 3 = two to three weeks. placeholder: true means the spec is not written yet, so the task cannot be claimed. Every task needs docs/qa/<ID>.md (independent QA criteria) before it can be claimed; see docs/qa/README.md.

tasks.title: Resource library and RAG indexing, with per-class library settings and uploads
tasks.done_when: Library uploads are chunked and embedded, and searchLibrary returns ranked passages. Per D11, a class can set each shared document to agent, tutor, both or off, and upload its own documents. Search for a class covers the shared library plus its uploads with its settings applied, and never returns another class's uploads. ClassConfig contracts gain the library settings. Vector search always filters by curriculum (and class for uploads) or uses hnsw.iterative_scan, so row-level security never returns fewer than k results (F4 QA finding 3)
